A 1kg sample of aluminium is stored in a laboratory. In a different laboratory, in the same town,
there is a 1kg sample of iron.
Which quantity must these two samples always have in common?
A
the same density
B
the same temperature
C
the same volume
D
the same weight
subject: Physics
